Definition: from a derivative of G5138; rough district; Trachonitis, a region of Syria:--Trachonitis.
BiblicalUsage: Luke dates the ministry of John the Baptist by the rulers of the day, and Philip, tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, is one of the names on the list. Luke dates the ministry of John the Baptist by the rulers of the day, and Philip, tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, is one of the names on the list.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the dating is the point: the gospel begins in a dated year, under named rulers, in real districts — and Trachonitis is one of them.
